Marley foretells that Scrooge will be visited by Three Spirits as his only chance of redemption.
Scrooge treats his cold clerk harshly and threatens him with dismissal.
Scrooge refuses the charity collector's plea for holiday donations for the poor.
Fred invites Scrooge to Christmas dinner, but Scrooge scornfully refuses.
Scrooge begrudges Cratchit his Christmas Day holiday and strictly expects him back early the following day.
